A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you join.

Is LIVVELL available now?

LIVVELL is in development. Join for updates or apply to be an early tester. Invitations and availability will be shared by email.

What will early testers do?

Try the MVP in everyday life and share feedback on meal suggestions, check-ins and the overall experience. We’ll share the testing details before you decide to participate.

Is this a diet plan or medical service?

LIVVELL is designed to support everyday food awareness and choices. It does not diagnose conditions or replace medical care. Meal ideas and personal observations are not guarantees of how you will feel.

Do I need a wearable?

The core experience starts with your own check-ins. You can explore meals and reflect on how they landed without a wearable.

What happens to my email?

This form collects your email, chosen interest and any optional details you provide so the LIVVELL team can contact you about launch or testing. It does not ask for health information. You can ask to be removed by replying to a LIVVELL email. See the privacy notice for details.

PRIVACY NOTICE

How we handle your email.

What we collect. When you join, we collect the email address you enter, your optional name, and whether you chose updates or testing. If you apply to test, we also collect the phone type you choose, if any. We keep a record that you agreed to receive email and which version of the consent wording you saw. We don’t ask for health information.

Why. Only to email you about LIVVELL launch updates and, if you applied, testing invitations and next steps.

What we don’t do. We don’t sell your information or use it for advertising. This page sets no cookies and uses no analytics or advertising trackers.

How long. We keep your details only as long as we need them for the purposes above.

Your choices. You can withdraw your consent, or ask to see, correct or delete your information, at any time by replying to any email from LIVVELL.
